text: Oh, she's brilliant. Does the big conferences, gets quoted in the papers. Bit terrifying, mind.
style: Front-desk receptionist at a smart tech firm, mid-twenties. Speak with a consistent South Wales (Cardiff) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Bright, slightly high pitch; quick, chatty pace. Genuinely friendly, a little in awe of her boss and not remotely suspicious of visitors.
